record.bible_text: Canst thou draw out<WH04900><WTH8799> leviathan<WH03882> with an hook<WH02443>? or his tongue<WH03956> with a cord<WH02256> <FI>which<Fi> thou lettest down<WH08257><WTH8686>? <RF>leviathan: probably an extinct animal of some kind<Rf> <RF>which...: Heb. which thou drownest?<Rf>

Lay<WH07760><WTH8798> thine hand<WH03709> upon him, remember<WH02142><WTH8798> the battle<WH04421>, do no more<WH03254><WTH8686>.
Behold, the hope<WH08431> of him is in vain<WH03576><WTH8738>: shall not <FI>one<Fi> be cast down<WH02904><WTH8714> even at the sight<WH04758> of him?

Who hath prevented<WH06923><WTH8689> me, that I should repay<WH07999><WTH8762> <FI>him? whatsoever is<Fi> under the whole heaven<WH08064> is mine.

<FI> His<Fi> scales<WH04043><WH0650> <FI>are his<Fi> pride<WH01346>, shut up together<WH05462><WTH8803> <FI>as with<Fi> a close<WH06862> seal<WH02368>. <RF>scales: Heb. strong pieces of shields<Rf>
One<WH0259> is so near<WH05066><WTH8799> to another<WH0259>, that no air<WH07307> can come<WH0935><WTH8799> between them.
They are joined<WH01692><WTH8792> one<WH0376> to another<WH0251>, they stick together<WH03920><WTH8691>, that they cannot be sundered<WH06504><WTH8691>.
By his neesings<WH05846> a light<WH0216> doth shine<WH01984><WTH8686>, and his eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> like the eyelids<WH06079> of the morning<WH07837>.
Out of his mouth<WH06310> go<WH01980><WTH8799> burning lamps<WH03940>, <FI>and<Fi> sparks<WH03590> of fire<WH0784> leap out<WH04422><WTH8691>.
Out of his nostrils<WH05156> goeth<WH03318><WTH8799> smoke<WH06227>, as <FI>out<Fi> of a seething<WH05301><WTH8803> pot<WH01731> or caldron<WH0100>.
His breath<WH05315> kindleth<WH03857><WTH8762> coals<WH01513>, and a flame<WH03851> goeth out<WH03318><WTH8799> of his mouth<WH06310>.
In his neck<WH06677> remaineth<WH03885><WTH8799> strength<WH05797>, and sorrow<WH01670> is turned into joy<WH01750><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him. <RF>is turned into joy: Heb. rejoiceth<Rf>
The flakes<WH04651> of his flesh<WH01320> are joined together<WH01692><WTH8804>: they are firm<WH03332><WTH8803> in themselves; they cannot be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>. <RF>flakes: Heb. fallings<Rf>
His heart<WH03820> is as firm<WH03332><WTH8803> as a stone<WH068>; yea, as hard<WH03332><WTH8803> as a piece<WH06400> of the nether<WH08482> <FI>millstone<Fi> .
When he raiseth up<WH07613> himself, the mighty<WH0352> are afraid<WH01481><WTH8799>: by reason of breakings<WH07667> they purify<WH02398><WTH8691> themselves.
The sword<WH02719> of him that layeth<WH05381><WTH8688> at him cannot hold<WH06965><WTH8799>: the spear<WH02595>, the dart<WH04551>, nor the habergeon<WH08302>. <RF>habergeon: or, breastplate<Rf>
He esteemeth<WH02803><WTH8799> iron<WH01270> as straw<WH08401>, <FI>and<Fi> brass<WH05154> as rotten<WH07539> wood<WH06086>.
The arrow<WH01121><WH07198> cannot make him flee<WH01272><WTH8686>: slingstones<WH068><WH07050> are turned<WH02015><WTH8738> with him into stubble<WH07179>.
Darts<WH08455> are counted<WH02803><WTH8738> as stubble<WH07179>: he laugheth<WH07832><WTH8799> at the shaking<WH07494> of a spear<WH03591>.
Sharp<WH02303> stones<WH02789> <FI>are<Fi> under him: he spreadeth<WH07502><WTH8799> sharp pointed things<WH02742> upon the mire<WH02916>. <RF>Sharp stones: Heb. Sharp pieces of potsherd<Rf>
He maketh the deep<WH04688> to boil<WH07570><WTH8686> like a pot<WH05518>: he maketh<WH07760><WTH8799> the sea<WH03220> like a pot of ointment<WH04841>.
He maketh a path<WH05410> to shine<WH0215><WTH8686> after<WH0310> him; <FI>one<Fi> would think<WH02803><WTH8799> the deep<WH08415> <FI>to be<Fi> hoary<WH07872>.
Upon earth<WH06083> there is not his like<WH04915>, who is made<WH06213><WTH8803> without<WH01097> fear<WH02844>. <RF>is made without fear: or, behave themselves without fear<Rf>
He beholdeth<WH07200><WTH8799> all high<WH01364> <FI>things<Fi> : he <FI>is<Fi> a king<WH04428> over all the children<WH01121> of pride<WH07830>.<CM>
